run_benchmark_main: run the benchmark main function with a DictConfig containing model, loader, and benchmarker
test_benchmarker: test the Benchmarker with a PyTorch model and DataLoader to evaluate performance
instantiate_model: instantiate a PyTorch nn.Module from a DictConfig using instantiate_and_ensure_is_instance
instantiate_dataloader: instantiate a DataLoader from a DictConfig using instantiate_and_ensure_is_instance
compute_benchmark_metrics: compute benchmark metrics from a tested Benchmarker instance
